Most Villains don’t have the heart to fire a third barrel on blank rivers like this. They're happy to simply fold out some of Hero’s gutshots and A-x on the turn. Very few players go after Q-Q - 10-10 and 9-x combos on rivers like this. As a result, Hero can comfortably fold 8¥-7¥ to a river barrel and know he’s not getting exploited.
